question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Scarce
solution:
The correct answer is '**Ample**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**scarce**" means insufficient or in short supply. (अपर्याप्त)
 
• The opposite of "**scarce**" is "**ample**," which means plentiful or sufficient in quantity. (पर्याप्त)
 
• The other options: "**heavy**," "**tiny**," and "**less**" do not represent the correct antonym.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Sentence:** *Resources are scarce__ in some remote areas, but urban regions often have __ample__ supplies.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Heavy (भारी)**: means having great weight or density.
 
• **Tiny (छोटा)**: means very small in size.
 
• **Less (कम)**: means smaller in amount or degree.
